content.text: Welcome to the Guardian Tomb world!
Did you come here to become|a Dynamon Captain?
Let's start by testing your SKILLS!
NICE! you have great potential.|Now choose your own Dynamon!
Great choice, you will make a great team!
Now, I have something to give you...
These ITEMS will be useful in your journey.
Speaking of which,|let's find a WILD DYNAMON...
Let's find some wild|Dynamons to BATTLE!
WAIT! Now that it's weak, let's|try to CATCH it!
WOW! Your Dynamon can LEVEL UP!
We use SHARDS to do that.|Use some now!
You can SWITCH Dynamons during battle.
Let's use the Duxedo you just caught!
That's Sofia, she is a trainer like you...
Go and BATTLE her!
During battles, you can use one ITEM per turn.
Use the SKILL CAN you just got!
Dynamons and Skills have TYPES...
Use the STRONG type when possible!
WOW, you're STRONG!|But I'm stronger!
Next time i won't lose!
You got access to a new location.
Let's go there!
Hi! My name is Julian...
Let's practice our battle technique!
Maybe I'm too old for this...
Great adventure ahead, | stay safe, my dear.
Dr Swan? How did you manage to|get into the Guardian Tomb?
The Gate Keeper just told me that anyone who has|8 Guardian blessing is allowed to enter with 3 other persons.
The Golden Elite has asked me, Dom, and the|Scientist to join him.
Trust me! My wisdom and experience|will guide us through anything.
I've spent years in my lab solving problems no one else|could. You're in good hands with me in your team!
With a team like this, you're practically unstoppable!|Maybe you can call yourself the dream team!
Alright dream team! Let's find out what|is going on in the Guardian Tomb.
Wait? Am I dreaming? You all don't|look like a spirit to me?
I thought only spirits could enter this place?
Shelldon? What are you doing here?
So I challenged the Gate Keeper many months|ago, but I lost his challenge.
I tried everything! But I can't get out!
Shelldon failed to win even the first Guardian blessing!
This is so embarrassing! Why did he just share that?
Shelldon, have you seen Manifesto?
Yeah, I just heard him complaining that he|can't get some cursed door to open.
This sounds like a job for our Scientist!
Interesting! I will inspect this cursed door.|Maybe there is a special way to open it!
I am so angry! I tried everything,|but I can't get my soul back!
Chuk, calm down! We are here to save you.
My girlfriend Jenni is waiting for me!|I need to get out of here!
CHUK!!!! STOP IT!|We are here to help you get your soul back!
Oh wait! I thought you were a spirit.|But you are alive?
How did you get in here without losing your soul?
The Golden Elite won all the Guardian blessings and|he was allowed to bring me, Dr. Swan and the Scientist.
That's great, but how are you planning to save my soul?
Let me speak and I will guide|everyone with my wisdom.
The Gate Keeper has taken all the souls from the spirits.
If we can free the souls, it would allow|all souls to return to their bodies!
So, when I get my soul back,|I can leave this place?
Dom, but I don't see any souls in this place?|Where could the Gate Keeper keep them?
With my experience that one was easy to figure out!
He keeps the lost souls in the staff!
Only the Gate Keeper can summon the power|of the soul staff. These souls are mine!
I found the cursed door!|It was at the end of the Guardian Tomb.
It seems to have a special lock that contains 8 symbols.
I just realized there are eight tombs here.|They have the symbols from the special lock!
Great work scientist! That first tomb up|ahead seems to contain a dark symbol.
Shelldon, you have been here for|a long time. Do you know why that|tombstone has a dark symbol on it?
Don't come near that tombstone!
Please be quiet! Don't wake him up!
Shelldon is acting strange.
Maybe this Raider spirit can tell us|something more about the tombstone?
No way! I am not getting|near that tombstone again!
Raider spirit, why does that|tombstone scare you so much?
There is an evil Dynamon buried in it!
Don't you hear its terrifying growling sound?
Chuk, do you know which evil Dynamon|is buried under that Tombstone?
Watch out! Don't stand near the|tombstone! You will make him angry!
Chuk, what does that evil Dynamon look like?
It looks like a really scary dead bear!
Ferguson, have you seen this evil dead bear?
Some time ago I saw Manifesto,|getting near that tombstone.
This is what I saw: An evil dark type bear|wearing armor appeared and he tried to|attack Manifesto!
What happened to Manifesto?
I don't know. I got scared and ran away!
I figured it out! I know who this scary evil Dynamon is!
A person who has lived as long as I,|could easily figure this one out!
So who is this evil Dynamon?
This must be the tombstone from the very first|legendary Bearmoryx! I remember it|from my childhood stories.
Bearmoryx was asked by the Guardian King|to protect 1 of the 8 sacred crystals.
That sounds like the 8 crystals|we need to open the cursed door.
So is there anyone brave enough to lure|Bearmoryx out of its grave?
Step a side everyone! I will help you out!|No evil Dynamon can scare me!
Klaude, is that really you?
Dead Bearmoryx, I call upon you!|Appear before us!
Golden Elite, do you think you can|defeat the Dead Bearmoryx?
I can't believe it! The Golden Elite|actually defeated the dead Bearmoryx!
Anyone who defeats a dead Dynamon|will be able to command it in battle.
Look the first Dark scared crystal appeared!
I have a theory about the tombs and the sacred crystals.
I don't think the Golden Elite was the first|one to have claimed the Dark sacred crystal.
What do you mean?
The dark tomb is still glowing! I have theory|that anyone who challenges a dead legendary|can win a sacred crystal.
So any person who has all 8 sacred crystals|will be able to open the cursed door.
I wonder how many sacred crystals|are already won by Manifesto?
Look, there is another tomb up ahead!
We should be able to win the|Water sacred crystal over there.
We need to be prepared and know how to|defeat the next dead Water legendary!
Shelldon, could you help us out|with the next water tomb?
I am so sorry! It was an accident!
Shelldon, what are you talking about?|You are not making any sense!
I can't get close to that tomb! That Water|legendary wants to take his revenge on me!
Shelldon, what did you do?
It was an accident that happened|at Costa Gueta Island.
Chuk, do you have any idea what|Shelldon was talking about?
You mean the accident that happened|at Costa Gueta Island?
All I know is that Shelldon used to go|hunting for fish in the sea with a big spear.
Chuk told us about your fish hunt. What happened?
I was trying to catch fish with my spear in the|sea, but then something went horribly wrong!
The great legendary Sharkonyx|was swimming in the Costa Gueta sea.
I thought it was a tasty fish in the sea,|so I threw my spear at it.
This can't be true? Did you kill|the great Sharkonyx who guards the sea?
It was an accident! How was I supposed|to know he was swimming there!
We need to find a way to lure the|dead Sharkonyx out of his grave!
Dr. Swan, I just got the perfect idea!
Dead Sharkonyx, it was Shelldon who|killed you with that spear!
Dom??? What are you doing?|Don't make him angry!
Dead Sharkonyx, come take your revenge!|Shelldon is right here!
Great work Dom! It is working!|The Dead Sharkonyx just came out of his grave!
I'm too young to be shark food!|Please spare me dead Sharkonyx!
Shelldon, no need to worry anymore!|The Golden Elite defeated the dead Sharkonyx!
Actually Shelldon might still have a problem. Anyone|can challenge a dead legendary for a sacred crystal here.
What? So you mean this dead Sharkonyx|is going to haunt me forever!
Until we free Shelldon's soul from the Gatekeeper's soul|staff, the dead Sharkonyx will continue to haunt him!
Mwhahah! Shelldon's soul will remain|trapped in my soul staff for eternity!
Let me update you on my latest research about|the cursed door at the end of this cave.
I installed sound sensors on the cursed door and|they detected a noise behind the door.
A noise? Does that mean someone is on the|other side of the cursed door already?
Could it be Manifesto? Did he already|win all the sacred crystals?
Give me some more time. I will try to figure out|what is happening behind the cursed door.
Dr. Swan, I don't think that Manifesto|has opened up the cursed door yet.
How come you are so sure about that?
I just saw Manifesto at that Earth Tomb!|He just won the Earth sacred crystal!
Maybe we can use that to our advantage and|learn how to call out the dead Earth legendary.
Raider spirit, did you see how Manifesto was able to|call out the Earth legendary out of its tomb?
That lying traitor Manifesto!! I will help you!
This is what I saw. Manifesto used a specific|Gold Legendary that had a weapon in its hand.
Sorry I don't know the name of|that Gold Legendary Dynamon.
I wonder, which Gold type Dynamon could that be?
Dr. Swan, I know which Gold legendary Dynamon|can call out the Dead Earth legendary out of its tomb!
I remember the story now from my childhood.
Knightanyx wanted to become 1|of the Guardian King's 8 titans.
Knightanyx challenged the Earth titan|Crocynos to a battle.
Crocynos won honorably, but Knightanyx was furious|and stabbed him with his sword!
What? But Crocynos was already|declared as the match winner!
Crocynos died from that injury. However the|Guardian King banished Knightanyx for playing unfair.
Using Knightanyx in battle near the Earth Grave|will surely awaken the dead Crocynos!
Golden Elite, we need your help! Say Knightanyx|and the dead Crocynos will appear!
Look, it worked! Crocynos has risen from the dead!
Watch out Golden Elite! The dead Crocynos|is very angry and wants its revenge!
Look! The sword from Knightanyx is|still in the dead body from Crocynos!
The score is now settled against Knightanyx and the|dead Crocynos! We received the Earth sacred crystal.
And the Golden Elite can now command|the dead Crocynos in battle!
Dr. Swan, watch out!|That traitor Manifesto is here!
What? How did you figure out|to summon the Dead Crocynos?
I thought I was the only one who knew that secret!
Let's see if my army of dead legendaries|can defeat yours!
What? How were you able to defeat my|army of dead legendaries?
Either way, only I know the secrets to making|all the titans rise from their graves!
You'll never win the remaining 5 Sacred Crystals!
Dr. Swan, I've completed my analysis of|the sound behind the cursed door.
I can now tell you exactly what's|happening behind the cursed door!
The sound was a shovel digging up dirt.
I believe someone was digging up|the Guardian King's grave.
Why would anyone want to dig up that grave?
Dr. Swan, I know someone who has a reason to|dig up the Guardian King's grave!
SUMSUM has the power to revive any dead|Dynamon, as long as its bones are intact.
And if SUMSUM already has the bones,|he could begin the revival process.
I just saw something terrifying walking through here!
Raider, what did you see?
I'm gone! I don't want to get|burned by that creature!
Look, I see the Earth Elite's father over there.
I just saw the strangest thing in this cave.|You won't believe it!
Christos, what was that weird thing that you saw?
I've seen the fire unicorn Horzaryx before,|with a fire horn on its head.
But this unicorn was pure fire with|a horn that looked like ice!
That's something worth investigating further!
Maybe my son can tell you more about it?
Earth Elite, we need your help.
In order to win the next Sacred Crystal, we|need to awaken the Fire legend from its grave.
I think I know what caused its death.
That dead unicorn . . .  it|wasn't born with an ice horn!
Look closer! Part of Glixonyx's ice|trident is still stuck in its skull!
Wait... I remember an old legend|about this battle!
Long ago, Horzaryx was the Fire Titan.|He got challenged by Glixonyx to a duel.
Glixonyx won because of his type advantage,|but Horzaryx refused to accept defeat.
Horzaryx was enraged and he charged at Glixonyx|in a final attempt to strike him down.
In that moment Glixonyx tried to stop him with|his trident... but it pierced Horzaryx's head,|ending the battle forever.
That must be why the dead Horzaryx|is still seeking revenge.
I have an idea! Meet me at the Fire tombstone!
Legends say that titans never truly die.|They wait for the chance to rise again.
If Horzaryx hears of the one who defeated|him, his spirit might awaken.
Only then will the fallen Horzaryx return!
Incredible! The ice trident has fused into|Horzaryx's skull, forming a new deadly horn!
That's not just a scar. It's a weapon! Horzaryx might|be able to use a special water attack now!
Golden Elite, history has repeated itself.|Glixonyx still reigns as the true champion!
Now I remember after Horzaryx fell, Glixonyx ended|the war between Fire and Water Dynamons.
Glixonyx wasn't just a warrior.|He was a true hero.
And look at this Fire Sacred Crystal!|It's absolutely magnificent!
Dr. Swan, the sensors on the door|picked up a new sound.
Based on my analysis, I can tell|what's happening behind the door.
My sound recording detected 4 guards.|They were dragging bones somewhere.
Only 4 guards? No sign of SUMSUM?
SUMSUM voice isn't in the recording.|I think the guards are still preparing.
I believe I know what the guards|are preparing for SUMSUM!
If my childhood stories are true,|there's a revival pad somewhere in this cave.
That would explain everything!|It must be behind this door!
And based on my analysis, the|preparations seem to be complete now.
Then we have to move fast|and find the next sacred crystal.
SUMSUM hasn't revived the Guardian King|yet. We can still stop him!
Dr. Swan, I just witnessed something|unbelievable at the Electric tomb!
There's a skull shaped head|trying to dig its way out!
Incredible! Could it be the|dead Electric legendary?
This can't be real...  Of course,|I recognize that skull shaped head!
I'm from the Chinese Festival Town. Of all people,|I would recognize that head anywhere!
The head is from the Chinese dragon Draxygus!
Draxygus? That makes no sense...
Why would a Fire legendary emerge|from the Electric Tomb?
I have a theory, this legendary may|have emerged from its grave before.
Shelldon has been here for ages.|Maybe he has seen it rise from its grave?
Shelldon, have you ever seen the|electric legendary rise from its grave?
You mean the terrifying electric|legendary that roams at night?
The Electric legendary is Visi! He was|killed in a fierce battle with Draxygus!
But with his dying breath, Visi killed Draxygus|by stabbing its head with his sharp tail.
Now he wanders here at night,|carrying the Draxygus skull as his trophy.
Dr. Swan, this Draxygus skull must have|belonged to the very first Chinese dragon!!
Chinese dragon name is Draxygus. This|might be what brings Visi out of its grave!
Look, it worked! Visi has|risen out of its grave!
No... this can't be! I think Visi|merged with Draxygus!
Look! The eyes on the|Draxygus skull are glowing!
Watch out! Visi might be able to|use a special fire attack now!
It seems our Draxygus finally got revenge for|his ancient ancestor that was slain by Visi.
And now the Golden Elite can command the|dead Visi and use its special fire skill!
And we've received this incredible|Electric sacred crystal! 3 more to go!
Dr. Swan, there are some strange|stones on the ground.
Oops! I just stepped on 1 of those stones.
Scientist! What have you done?|That stone was a trap!
Careful! Those golden spikes are deadly!
Well done! You made it through alive.
We need to figure out how these gold spikes|are linked to the Diamond Tomb.
There's something about the shape|of that spike. It feels so familiar.
I see the Christos spirit over there.|Maybe he knows more.
Christos, we're trying to summon the Diamond Titan.
But suddenly these gold spikes came from the ground.
